completion:
Enter the date of the incident on which it occurred.
3. Describe the work activities in progress, including those immediately preceding the incident.
4. Complete the demeanor/condition of the worker at the time of the incident. Did they voice pain? Were they able to walk to the break room?
5. Enter the time that the injury took place.
6. List and/or describe all hazardous conditions surrounding the incident including equipment failure, exposure to chemicals, electrical cords in walkways, etc.
7. Complete the supervisor's name and the location of the incident.
8. The remainder of the report should then be completed including witnesses and the root cause analysis.
9. Provide the medical provider as well as the employer's description of the incident. (If more room is needed, please continue on a separate sheet of paper)

Our goal is to submit the workplace accident summary within 10 calendar days of the evaluation.
